name: Temporal Score Rescaling (TSR)
plain: Post-CFG rescale of the score that steers output diversity by a signal-to-noise dependent ratio. The node text says lower k gives more detail and higher k gives smoother results; k=1 turns it off.
math:
snr = exp(2·half_log_snr(σ)); r = (snr·σ_t²+1)/(snr·σ_t²/k+1), r=k when snr=+∞
D' = lerp(x/α, D, r), α = σ·exp(half_log_snr)
Skip if k=1, σ=0 or snr=0.

props.architectures: Uses sigma_to_half_log_snr, which branches by model_sampling type; not gated to any architecture.
